name: print-social-navy-and-royal-blue-ai-analytics-post-grid
title: Nine navy and royal-blue AI-service posts with portraits, tags and checklist cards
whatItIs: A dark board headed with an agency logo above a 3x3 grid of deep-blue posts. Each mixes bold sans titles like 'AI Analytics' and 'Built For Teams' with cut-out professionals, small light-blue tag chips, white checklist cards and stat panels.
whatItMeans: Professional and clear; navy with light blue accents feels dependable for tech services.
techniques: Combine navy backgrounds with pale-blue tag chips.
Use white checklist cards as content blocks.
Mix cutout portraits with data panels.
Keep type in one bold sans.

vocabulary.definition: A small pill labelling a topic.
A card listing benefits with tick marks.
A set of posts sharing structure.
